objective: lets create a brand new github repo for a new project. Elite Dangerous MCP service. We want to be able to ask an LLM plain english queries that will check both local journal files from the game as well as the public EDDN elite dangerous data network and data used by Inara.cz and Spansh. Examples of queries might be find all stars within 15 light years of the stars in the Teapot constellation that have zero population and are claimable to set up my own brand new space station. Or: make a shopping list to set up my Anaconda as a maximum cargo space hauling ship and it will find which nearby stations, using local journal files to always find your current system location, and gather the modules needed to buy, where to get them from, and how much they cost.
